newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana-Pacific to close window plant.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana-Pacific to close window plant.

text.p: Louisiana-Pacific Corp said it will permanently close its window manufacturing plant in Sacramento, California this month.

"Unfortunately, we haven't been able to achieve profitability at this plant or define a strategy that will achieve an acceptable return in the forseeable future," Tom Dick, general manager of the company's window and door business, said in a statement.
The company was not immediately available to say how many employees would be affected by the closure.
